messages:
emma: Quick sync: playing with a denser scorecard layout for prompt-eval runs. Concern: when rows shrink we lose reviewer rationale. How do we keep the "why" without killing density?
rafael: Yeah, the compact rows become a sea of chips. Most reviewers want to jot 1-2 words. Maybe we reserve a 1-line peek for reviewer gist that truncates.
priya: Important for screen reader users: any truncated text must still be readable via an inline reveal button. Otherwise SR users get nothing.
alex: Thought: show a single-token reason pill (e.g., "concise") + a small "more" affordance that opens a stacked panel with full note. Keeps rows slim.
emma: Microcopy options for the pill: "Reason: concise", just the word "concise", or an icon + tooltip. Which reads better at glance?
rafael: Preference for short word + higher weight. Human intent should read stronger than model score. So reviewer pill should be bolder and slightly darker.
priya: a11y: ensure the pill has aria-label like `Reviewer reason: concise, opens details` and keyboard focus. Also the stacked panel opening should move focus into panel and trap until closed.
alex: UX tweak: when approving multiple diffs we should surface a compact summary toast that includes the first 80 chars of reviewer note, not just "approved". That avoids losing context on bulk actions.
emma: Draft announcement phrasing: `Approval recorded for {n} items. Reviewer note preview: {summary}` Would that be polite?
priya: Use polite live region announcing only when the user performs the action, and mark it polite so it doesn't interrupt reading. Also include `Changed focus to {diff id}` or return focus to nearest visible diff.
rafael: Copy A/B ideas for the primary CTA: A) `Confirm and record` B) `Approve and note` C) `Approve (no note)` — we could add a small dropdown for variants.
alex: Keyboard behavior: Enter on approve opens inline note. Ctrl+Enter submits. This avoids accidental quick approvals.
emma: Concern: discoverability for the inline-note behavior. Maybe a subtle helper: `Press Enter to add note` that appears on CTA hover/focus.
priya: Accessibility nits: color contrast on the reviewer pill at small sizes needs testing. Also ensure initials fallback for avatars in compact mode (screen readers should still read full name in modal).
rafael: Fig link with mock: https://figma.redwood/denser-scorecard-001 comments on the right.
emma: Action items: Rafael to produce 2 mocks (pill + stacked panel, pill + inline reveal), Alex to prototype keyboard/submit mapping, Priya to write SR announcement copy and contrast checklist. I'll collect microcopy variants and schedule a quick hallway test with 5 keyboard-first folks.
alex: I'll prototype keyboard in storybook and share link.
priya: Draft announcement: `Approval saved for {n} items. Reviewer note: "{first 80 chars}". Focus returned to list.` Posting that in the PRD now.
emma: thanks team — leaning toward pill + stacked panel + Enter->open note. Will follow up with copy choices tomorrow. :sparkles:
